mx.teacher_note: Microalgae supply nitrogen rather than oxygen when they make food using sunlight.

mx.teacher_note: Microalgae can keep making their own food by this process even in permanent darkness.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Conserving microalgae increases pollution because abundant microalgae cause it.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Every microalga has the same nutritional value as Spirulina.

intelligence.enrichment: Microalgae are microscopic plant-like organisms that live in water, soil, air, and even on trees. They make their own food using sunlight, help maintain oxygen balance, and conserving them supports the environment, food security, and livelihood development. Microalgae use sunlight and remain diverse and abundant -> oxygen balance and useful food-related resources are supported. The learner correctly applies this rule: Microalgae are microscopic plant-like organisms that live in water, soil, air, and even on trees. They make their own food using sunlight, help maintain oxygen balance, and conserving them supports the environment, food security, and livelihood development. Microalgae are just pond scum, so losing them would not affect oxygen, food, or people.
